# relyance_business_nodes (Data Source)

The tenant's business nodes, as lookup maps. Use by_name to reference nodes in connection arguments without knowing record ids: business_node_ids = [data.relyance_business_nodes.all.by_name["Engineering"]].

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "relyance_business_nodes" "all" {}

# Reference nodes by name in connection arguments:
# business_node_ids = [data.relyance_business_nodes.all.by_name["Engineering"]]

output "node_names" {
  value = keys(data.relyance_business_nodes.all.by_name)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `by_id` (Map of String) Map of record id → node name.
- `by_name` (Map of String) Map of node name → record id.
- `nodes` (Attributes List) All business nodes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes))

<a id="nestedatt--nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nodes`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Record id.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `type` (String) Node type (business entity or product).
